name: Single Card Draw
summary: The foundational daily focus, quick query, or clarifier draw.
author: Traditional

instructions.preparation: Take three deep breaths, formulate a singular intention or ask 'What energy asks for my attention today?'
instructions.shuffle: Shuffle the deck until you feel an intuitive stop.
instructions.drawing: Draw the top card or cut the deck and take the cut card.
instructions.synthesis: Meditate on the imagery, symbols, and core essence of the card in relation to your day or question.

slots.description: The central theme, active energy, or lesson for the query.
